faqs.question: What does AFB (TB) – Antibiogram for MTb Complex – Levofloxacin Drug by MGIT – Pure Growth of MTB Complex measure?
faqs.answer: This test measures the drug susceptibility of the MTb complex (Mycobacterium tuberculosis complex) to levofloxacin, an antibiotic used in the treatment of tuberculosis (TB).

faqs.question: Why is AFB (TB) – Antibiogram for MTb Complex – Levofloxacin Drug by MGIT – Pure Growth of MTB Complex done?
faqs.answer: • This test helps determine if the bacteria causing the tuberculosis infection are responsive or resistant to levofloxacin. • To guide the selection of antibiotics for treating TB based on drug susceptibility. • To monitor the effectiveness of ongoing TB treatment. • To identify drug-resistant strains of the MTb complex. • To prevent the development and spread of drug-resistant TB strains.

faqs.question: When is AFB (TB) – Antibiogram for MTb Complex – Levofloxacin Drug by MGIT – Pure Growth of MTB Complex recommended and who should take the test?
faqs.answer: This test is recommended for • Patients diagnosed with TB to determine their specific drug susceptibility profile. • Patients with a history of non-response or relapse during TB treatment. • Individuals suspected of having drug-resistant TB due to close contact with a known case. • Patients who have completed initial treatment for TB but are experiencing persistent symptoms.

faqs.question: What if the results of AFB (TB) – Antibiogram for MTb Complex – Levofloxacin Drug by MGIT – Pure Growth of MTB Complex are abnormal?
faqs.answer: Abnormal results may suggest resistance to levofloxacin, requiring alternative antibiotics or modified treatment regimens.

faqs.question: What to expect during AFB (TB) – Antibiogram for MTb Complex – Levofloxacin Drug by MGIT – Pure Growth of MTB Complex?
faqs.answer: During the collection process, a sputum or other appropriate sample will be collected for testing.

faqs.question: What preparations are required before AFB (TB) – Antibiogram for MTb Complex – Levofloxacin Drug by MGIT – Pure Growth of MTB Complex?
faqs.answer: Please reach out to your healthcare provider for any specific requirements.

faqs.question: What other tests may be ordered with AFB (TB) – Antibiogram for MTb Complex – Levofloxacin Drug by MGIT – Pure Growth of MTB Complex?
faqs.answer: • TB culture and sensitivity testing to assess drug susceptibility against other antibiotics • Chest X-ray to evaluate the extent of lung involvement in TB

faqs.question: What is AFB (TB) – Antibiogram for MTb Complex – Levofloxacin Drug by MGIT – Pure Growth of MTB Complex also known as?
faqs.answer: MTb complex levofloxacin susceptibility testing, MTb complex drug sensitivity testing for levofloxacin

faqs.question: What is tuberculosis (TB)?
faqs.answer: Tuberculosis, commonly known as TB, is an infectious disease caused by the bacteria Mycobacterium tuberculosis. It primarily affects the lungs but can also impact other organs. TB is usually spread through the air when an infected individual coughs or sneezes. It can cause symptoms such as persistent cough, weight loss, fatigue, and night sweats.
